description: This file defines the class SugarWebServiceUtilv3, which extends a web service helper class and provides methods for handling SOAP web service functionalities specific to SuiteCRM, including field filtering, relationship retrieval, module metadata access, and upcoming activities management.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv3
classes.description: A SOAP web service utility class for SuiteCRM, offering methods for field filtering, relationship management, module metadata retrieval, and upcoming activity notifications.

methods.name: get_name_value
methods.description: Returns an associative array with a field name and its value, converting Link2 objects to empty strings if they don't implement __toString.

methods.name: filter_fields
methods.description: Filters a list of fields based on invalid contact fields and specific field definition criteria, mainly used to prepare lists of fields for data retrieval.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Retrieves related bean data for a specified relationship, applying filters, formatting date fields, and hiding user hashes for security.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Returns metadata about the fields of a given module bean, including label translation, options, and linkage information.

methods.name: get_subpanel_defs
methods.description: Loads subpanel definitions for a module based on metadata files and filters available subpanels according to access permissions.

methods.name: get_module_view_defs
methods.description: Loads view definitions such as list or subpanel views for a specified module.

methods.name: get_visible_modules
methods.description: Returns the list of modules that are enabled and visible to the current user based on system tabs and permissions.

methods.name: get_upcoming_activities
methods.description: Fetches the upcoming activities (meetings, calls, tasks, opportunities) assigned to the current user, sorted by due date.

methods.name: generateUpcomingActivitiesWhereClause
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause for retrieving upcoming activities based on date, status, and user filters.

methods.name: format_upcoming_activities_entries
methods.description: Formats raw bean data into a standardized array with id, module, due date, and summary for upcoming activities.

methods.name: cmp_datedue
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting activities by due date in ascending order.
